scientific_question: Can a strictly accepted 16-node real-HeadCalc state pair be constructed with essentially identical total profile water but sufficiently different vertical distribution by changing internal throughflow/redistribution while imposing zero integrated external flux divergence?

time_design.t0_rule: t0=(step-1)*dt, t1=step*dt from fresh family origin
time_design.rationale: reuse the D02R1 representation-safe dyadic interval and avoid binary-duration aliasing

forcing_families.purpose: closed-column gravity redistribution at fixed total water
forcing_families.selection_role: candidate redistributed origins at each accepted commit

execution_contract: each family starts from the same freshly constructed B01 Se=0.85 physical origin
every interval uses kernel Reference-floor sample semantics with exactly one physical advance and no automatic temporal subdivision
only strict samples satisfying the 1e-12 cm hard mass gate may commit
a failed sample is retained as fail-closed evidence and terminates that family; no retry/fallback/tolerance relaxation is introduced
after each accepted commit only provenance plus committed H/theta node state are emitted for selection
bottom exchange, terminal flux and future-response quantities are neither emitted to nor parsed by the selector

response_blind_selection.candidate_pairs: EQ accepted control versus every accepted CLOSED state
response_blind_selection.no_match: Close E01 NO_MATCH without changing fluxes, dt, step limit or H2 thresholds.

qualification_gates: EQ strict sample accepted, mass complete and committed exactly once
CLOSED accepted prefix, if any, consists only of strict mass-complete samples
failed CLOSED interval, if any, leaves latest committed origin unchanged
selector parses only E01 provenance and node H/theta lines
selected pair, if any, is persisted with all 16 H/theta values before any response experiment
next_if_selected: GC-RZM06E02 preregisters exact common-time reconstruction of the immutable E01 selected pair on the C01 carrier, followed only after reconstruction passes by an identical forcing-free fixed-Hc H2 response probe.
controls: no ROM HELD_OUT or FALLBACK state access
no production source or coupling API change
nonclaims: E01 selection alone does not support or falsify H2
zero boundary-flux divergence constrains total mass but does not assert a particular internal redistribution trajectory
the construction is a research falsification carrier, not a production operating mode
